description: Run any nanoodle workflow: pass a share link as `url` (a nanoodle.com/#g=… workflow link, a nanoodle.com/play.html#a=… app link) OR a custom workflow graph you composed as `graph`, plus any workflow inputs as `inputs`. Design with noodle_guide, check the estimated cost with price_noodle (free), then run it here. Runs on NanoGPT — paid in NEAR or USDC on mainnet: a deposit is held up front, you are charged the actual model cost + 20% service fee, and the rest is refunded automatically — call price_noodle first for the itemized estimate. This paid server refuses short links, media inputs and node types it cannot price (see noodle_guide).

_pay_with.description: Choose the payment asset. Default near; usdc pays and refunds Circle-issued USDC on NEAR.

_payment_id.description: The paymentId from this tool's quote. After the pay page confirms payment, repeat the original arguments plus this id. Agents paying directly also supply _payment_tx and _payment_sender.

_payment_sender.description: The NEAR account you paid from. It locates the transaction; the refund goes to the transaction's signer.

_payment_tx.description: Hash (base58) of the exact quoted payment: one native Transfer for NEAR, or one ft_transfer on the quoted token contract for USDC.

graph.description: A custom workflow graph you composed: { "nodes": [{ "id", "type", "name"?, "fields": {...} }], "links": [{ "from": { "node", "port" }, "to": { "node", "port" } }] } (an object, or the same as a JSON string). Call noodle_guide for the node types, ports and priced models. Pass url OR graph.

inputs.description: Text inputs keyed by input name, e.g. { "Idea": "a lighthouse at dawn" }; this paid server accepts no media inputs. Omit to use the graph's saved text.

url.description: A full nanoodle share link with its #g=, #j= or #a= fragment (short links are refused here). Pass url OR graph.

name: run_noodle
